maya (ml-eng): Heads up — we need a per-route KPI card that attributes p50/p95/p99 token latency to kernel selection + KV cache behavior. current console cards only show overall token p95 which hides where regressions come from.

alex (runtime): totally. simplest breakdown is two dimensions: `kernel` + `kv_hit` (0/1). then percentile histograms per route.

tess (product): can we make the card show throughput & error rate alongside latency percentiles? PMs want a single view for SLA checks.

sam (sre): yes, + add request count and 5xx rate. also need sampling controls — full token histograms are heavy at high qps.

maya (ml-eng): proposal: emit a histogram metric `token_stage_ms` with label `stage` in {kv_lookup, kernel_compute, decode} and labels `route_id`, `kernel_version`, `kv_hit` (0/1). then Console widgets compute p50/p95/p99 by summing relevant stages or showing stacked waterfall.

alex (runtime): implementation notes: kernel attribution must include `kernel_version` label (e.g. avx2_v1, cu_blend_q4_v2). also important: aggregate by `route_id` and `seq_len_bucket` to avoid mixing short vs long seqs.

maya (ml-eng): sample PromQL examples for Console team:
```
# p95 kernel_compute for route chat-complete over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_stage_ms_bucket{route_id="chat-complete",stage="kernel_compute",kv_hit="1"}[5m])) by (le, kernel_version))
```

```
# kv hit ratio per route
sum(rate(token_stage_count{route_id="chat-complete",stage="kv_lookup",kv_hit="1"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(token_stage_count{route_id="chat-complete",stage="kv_lookup"}[5m]))
```

sam (sre): For sampling: emit full histograms at 1% of requests, then aggregated counters for all requests. Console can show sampled percentiles and exact counts for throughput. avoids cardinality explosion.

alex (runtime): caveat: adding `kernel_version` + `route_id` + `kv_hit` + `seq_len_bucket` increases label cardinality. let's cap by only including `kernel_version` when kernel differs from default; otherwise tag `default`. also keep `seq_len_bucket` coarse: short/medium/long.

tess (product): UX: card should default to route-level summary (p50/p95/p99, tok/s, 5xx%) and a toggle to open waterfall breakdown and kernel attribution table (top kernels by p95 and contribution%).

maya (ml-eng): can we add a small regression alert rule: if route p95 increases by >20% && kv_hit drops >5% in 10m then fire. ties perf regressions to KV behavior.

sam (sre): +1. also add a topn list: `top routes by p99 delta` for oncall rotations.

alex (runtime): I'll add the instrumentation PR to emit `token_stage_ms` (INF-4321). keeping default sampling 1% for histograms. Need Console query owners to wire panels.

maya (ml-eng): thanks — @alex can you include an example metric payload? infra folks want to see label cardinality estimates.

alex (runtime): example metric lines we plan to emit:
```
token_stage_ms_bucket{route_id="chat-complete",kernel_version="cu_blend_q4_v2",kv_hit="1",stage="kernel_compute",le="5"} 42
token_stage_count{route_id="chat-complete",kernel_version="cu_blend_q4_v2",kv_hit="1",stage="kernel_compute"} 1200
```

deploy-bot: metrics pushed to staging cluster: metric.token_stage_ms registered (PR: https://redwood.company/infra/pulls/2762) :rocket:

tess (product): plan sounds good. next steps: alex PR + Console tickets to add new per-route card with waterfall and kernel table. I'll create Console ticket and link INF-4321.

maya (ml-eng): agreed. owners: alex (runtime) for infra changes, tess (product) to spec Console layout, sam (sre) to author alerts.

sam (sre): I'll draft the alert rule and runbook.

alex (runtime): starting the PR today, ETA ~48h. will post a diff here once ready. :thumbsup:
